additional_concerns: node.b66b3e831bb98a12db59dffa omits the transition in d97b56331f41a.u10.1809: "Existing applications received by the SFC before the Effective Date for which no approval or authorisation has been granted will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process." Its substantive conditions alone do not establish relief for those applications.

All other candidates treat a pending pre-effective application as excluding relief for the change itself; d97b56331f41a.u10.1809 expressly preserves the processing of existing applications, but does not establish an indefinite exclusion for the underlying change after withdrawal or other subsequent events.

The effective date is supported by d97b56331f41a.u9.1696, but the source does not resolve every legally relevant event date; an assessment date must not silently substitute for an application or implementation date.
The referenced FAQs and forms are absent, and two dependencies are marked missing; the explicit exceptions can be checked, but detailed procedures and transitional edge cases remain unestablished.

FALSE denotes failure to satisfy the modeled removal conditions, not an independently established obligation to obtain prior approval; OUT_OF_SCOPE likewise does not resolve the applicable approval regime.
